searchText: Do you want to share a multiplatform-support Docker image for Reth? I was trying to build it for arm but it was talking hours. I can give it another try though <@577788234810130432> Can we add Reth FOCIL to the autobuilder? which branch? This one: https://github.com/PelleKrab/reth/tree/focil_impl Correct me if I'm wrong cc <@1122553751983628349> Are there any issues with including FOCIL in the same fork as shortening the slot duration? Imo this is upstream of the current discussion because delaying it longer than H* is a bad outcome I think the biggest risks are "unknown unknowns", not technical ones. I think there is a decent chance that FOCIL, by the H* fork, becomes unshippable because of regulatory/financial interests strongly advocating against it. i've added it to our scheduled builder it runs every hour, will check in on it in a bit Another question: is there any research I can read on stateless FOCIL providers? yes 🙂 https://ethresear.ch/t/a-pragmatic-path-towards-validity-only-partial-statelessness-vops/22236 the image is now available `ethpandaops/reth:pellekrab-focil_impl`
